written: 2026-10-18, after gates (extension/gates.json) and before any cv or test job
question: With the classifier as the only change, does NVIDIA Kumo Tabular (large) beat TabICLv2 (PAM = ft117, run fe1) on PAM's features, contexts, threshold rule and test set?
harness: extension/kumo_stack.py (select copied verbatim from deploy/ftemb_stack.py; sampling.build_context seed 0, budget 50,000) + extension/kumo_model.py

arms.kumo117: Kumo Tabular on the 117 ft117 columns, 4 fold contexts k=0..3, test score = mean of the 4
arms.PAM: fe1 ft117 (TabICLv2), the same 4 contexts, from build/ftemb_stack/fe1

jobs: cv: k=0..3 x protein sub-folds sub0..3 (16); test: k=0..3 (4); run id ku1
threshold_rule: per k: evaluate.choose_threshold (mean per-protein FPR <= 0.05) on the concatenated out-of-fold scores of the 4 sub-folds; frozen = median of the 4; written to extension/kumo_thresholds.json before test is read. PAM keeps its own step-10 threshold 0.3407.
criterion: paired 95% percentile bootstrap, 10,000 protein resamples, rng seed 0 (scripts/s2p_stack_report.paired), CB-full (231) per-protein AUPRC; two-sided: better if lower bound > 0, worse if upper bound < 0, else tie
context_not_claimed: TPR/FPR/MCC/F1/F1_weighted at each model's own CV-frozen threshold
rank_blend: fixed 50/50 within-protein rank average of kumo117 and PAM (exploratory)
not_covered: one context-draw seed (0), paired with fe1; PAM's 12-seed SD 0.0012 is quoted as context; Kumo's own seed variance is not measured
expectation: a tie within about +/-0.01 per-protein AUPRC (extension/PLAN.md, written before any job ran)
disclosure: the step-3 pilot exposed one CV block before this file was written: k=0/sub0 per-protein AUPRC kumo 0.3935 vs fe1 0.4006 (extension/gates.json). No test score has been produced. The expectation above was written before the pilot and is unchanged.
